scope: Current-process memory observations and deterministic simulated sample-clock event/checkpoint/replay verification; no physical hardware or sensor latency

checkpoint.recovery: Create PlaybackDevice and a new processor/session; active connections are not restored

raw_ring.scope: Fixed float64 sample/timestamp arrays only; excludes Python objects, locks and snapshots

processed_ring.scope: Fixed float64 sample/timestamp arrays only; excludes Python objects, locks and snapshots

resources.array_scope: Two fixed session rings only; processor windows, filter state, snapshots and Python objects are additional

process.current_rss_source: Linux procfs resident pages times OS page size
process.peak_rss_source: resource.RUSAGE_SELF.ru_maxrss; Linux KiB converted to bytes
process.scope: Entire current Python process including other modules, threads and native libraries; not acquisition-only
process.clock_note: Host monotonic observation time; no equivalence to device sample clock implied
process.unavailable_values: null means unavailable; not zero memory usage

limitations: Sample-clock annotation does not measure physiological event onset or host input latency
RSS belongs to the whole process, not acquisition only
Checkpoint contains the latest bounded raw contiguous window, not a full session or live process state
